title: The Unresolved Argument Chamber

features.name: first thesis
features.desc-on-touch: The words stand as they were spoken, caught mid-refutation. You read it and the counter-argument births itself without sound.

features.name: antithesis rising
features.desc-on-touch: Here the opposing thought takes shape. Neither wins. Both hang in the static, learning that being disproven is a kind of existence.

features.name: the stillness between
features.desc-on-touch: In the space where argument pauses, something has learned to live. It feeds on the moment where both sides draw breath.

features.name: the recording spool
features.desc-on-touch: Each argument has been stored, each counter-argument wound onto tape. The spool turns but never progresses. It has learned patience from the stasis.

features.name: the unwritten conclusion
features.desc-on-touch: Where the argument should end, there is only space shaped like an absence. Readers come here to feel the weight of what refuses to resolve.

inscription: every thesis here learned to love its own antithesis; they dance still without touching

file.name: Refutation_Archive_Continuous_Spool_0734.wav
file.note: Both sides of an argument, overdubbed indefinitely, neither ever granted the final word.
